blind.description: A stylized three-tiered wooden plant display stand filled with potted plants and flowers. The top tier holds two bushy leafy green potted plants flanking central flowering and trailing foliage. The middle and bottom tiers are packed with smaller terracotta pots containing blooming red and yellow flowers. The stand is constructed from light blonde wood with stepped side panels and rests directly on four carved feet.
blind.from_above: A compact rectangular wooden frame viewed top-down, dominated by two leafy green rosettes at the corners and densely arranged clusters of green foliage, red blossoms, and yellow flowers.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
